mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current level 1.16%) compresses discount rates and signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The negative relationship between FEDFUNDS and equity returns implies that the current low rate level causes positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS vs. 20d returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals economic weakness and recession risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The positive relationship between UNRATE and negative returns implies that when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, returns are negative.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC for UNRATE vs. 20d returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle to combat inflation, which increases equity risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The current FEDFUNDS (1.16%) and CPIAUCSL (247.592) indicate a rising trend in both, triggering the signal.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.2pp and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.5% in 3 months) occurs, but SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC for joint condition vs. returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (annualized rate > 2%) signals robust economic expansion, reducing recession risk and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The current GDP level (17169.733) implies a growth rate above 2% (annualized).
failure_condition: When GDP growth rate (annualized) exceeds 2%, SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC for GDP growth vs. 60d returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized) signals persistent inflation, leading to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The current CPIAUCSL (247.592) implies an annualized inflation rate above 3.0%.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (annualized), SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL vs. 20d returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months) combined with high housing starts (HOUST > 1200) signal robust consumer demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The joint condition of rising labor market and strong housing activity drives positive returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months AND HOUST > 1200
failure_condition: The joint condition (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months and HOUST > 1200) occurs, but SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC for joint condition vs. returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (current level 106.3969) signals robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The positive relationship between INDPRO and equity returns implies that the current high level causes positive returns.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 105, SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC for INDPRO vs. 5d returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1300) signal strong consumer demand and positive economic sentiment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The current HOUST (1290.0) is below this threshold, but the hypothesis is triggered when it exceeds 1300.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1300, SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC for HOUST vs. 20d returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
